summary: Backend-only testing of notification settings persistence. Verified PATCH /push/preferences/{user_id} saves notification_mode to MongoDB, PATCH /users/{user_id} saves notification_settings, and both values are returned in subsequent login responses. Full round-trip test (push→verify→reset) passed.
critical_code_review_comments: GET /auth/me is cookie-based only — no Bearer token support. In test env the cookie persists via session, so it works for the round-trip. This is fine by design but worth noting.
PATCH /push/preferences/{user_id} has no auth guard — any caller with the user_id can change the notification mode. Consider adding token validation.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All notification persistence endpoints verified working. PATCH /push/preferences/{user_id} correctly updates notification_mode in users collection. PATCH /users/{user_id} with notification_settings body persists. Login response includes both fields. Valid test user: forest@imosapp.com / Admin123! (id: 69a0b7095fddcede09591667).
